issues.desc: CHK-002 backward-compat 描述 koala.config.json 仍能读，但没说当只有 koala.config.json 存在时是否提示用户迁移到 lattice.config.json。从用户视角，无 deprecation 告知 = 用户永远不知道该改名，legacy fallback 会一直被沉默使用。建议 PLAN 阶段决策：旧路径是否输出一次性迁移提示，或在 diagnostics 里标注 legacy。不阻塞 INIT。

background 已经在「对话纹理」段点出用户视角（用户要 lattice/koala validate 不再出现 swift test），但「触发事件」「关键洞察」两段偏工程内省，没说用户在哪个具体操作流中被 swift test 打扰（比如『跑 koala validate 看到 swift test 失败但项目早就不用 Swift』）。当前 source=user request 2026-06-03 + 对话纹理已足够，但表述更贴近用户场景可减少未来 reviewer 误读。不阻塞 INIT。

CHK-001 adversarial (docs, must) and CHK-003 adversarial (docs, must) both assert Swift is no longer advertised as the default validation fallback. Tighten scope so one targets inline CLI/runtime-fact strings (e.g. validate diagnostics) and the other targets long-form docs (README, decisions/*.md), or merge — otherwise one finding will need duplicate evidence and could be silently waived.

Background introduces Lattice CLI / Orchestrate JS surface / Mac Native as known terms but does not inline-define their relationship. Fresh-context readers must follow relatedDocs (project-vision.md, testing-infra.md). Consider a one-sentence framing in background.md so the story is standalone.

CHK-002 adversarial (both config files coexist with conflicting validation config; diagnostics identify the winner) is priority=should, but config coexistence is the central rollout scenario for legacy repos. Re-evaluate whether this deserves must — silent priority loss here would lose the audit signal in case of conflict.
